desc:
🍭 Two choices. One outfit. What will YOUR final look be?

Welcome to Would You Rather: MIX Outfit Tower! 🍭
Pick between 2 avatar items at each stage and build your look as you climb a colorful candy obby!

👗 Pick your hair, clothes, heads & accessories!
🎲 Neither option your style? Tap MIX for a new random pair!
🧁 Climb a giant cupcake and hop across piano keys!
✨ Create a cute outfit… or a hilariously mismatched look!
📸 Reach the finish and show off your outfit in the photo zone!
👯 Play with friends and compare your final looks!

🍬 Try another run — what outfit will you make next?

🛍️ Earn rewards and explore the shop for trails, tools, music & effects!

⭐ Enjoyed playing? Like & favorite the game!
